topic: Key-value table editor (params + headers) bound to the active request tab's RequestSpec, with {{variable}} token highlighting/validation against the active environment; hand-rolled editable grid, build-vs-buy only on {{variable}} value-field autocomplete; pixel-fidelity to design/reference.html
verbatim_prompt: A key-value table editor used for both query params and request headers in an HTTP client. Each row: an enabled checkbox, a key field, a value field, and an optional description field. A trailing always-empty row auto-promotes to a real row on edit. Key and value fields highlight {{variable}} tokens and flag unknown ones against the active environment. It binds to the active request tab's RequestSpec (the params or headers array) already present in the renderer's tab state store — read and write that existing shape, do not invent a new one. The editable-grid mechanics (rows, auto-promote, focus movement) are simple enough to hand-roll, but if {{variable}} autocomplete is desired, evaluate a headless combobox/autocomplete primitive (Radix, React Aria, Downshift) for the value field rather than hand-rolling the listbox/keyboard behavior; if the UI primitives in specs/001-ui-primitives already adopted a headless library, reuse it rather than adding another. Build-vs-buy on the autocomplete only, the grid itself stays hand-rolled. The same component instanced twice with different bound data; do not split into two. Visual fidelity is MANDATORY: design/reference.html is the VISUAL TARGET to match to pixel parity, and the exact resolved values are pre-extracted in design/styles.css (:root + [data-theme="dark"]) and design/mintenvoy-design-fidelity-contract.md (sections "Key-Value editor" and "Pane tabs") — use those exact computed-style values (grid template, row height, cell mono font/size, header casing, padding, colour) as fidelity AC targets, treating var(--token) as resolves-to-token (not a literal hex). Copy the VALUES, never the CODE: the export carries generated cruft (data-om-* attributes, __OmT wrappers, inline styles, a tweaks-panel) that must NOT enter the build — rebuild with semantic class names bound to tokens.css. (Do NOT read tokens.json for values — it is reference-only and can drift; design/styles.css is authoritative.)

functional_scope.value: Hand-rolled editable key-value grid, one component instanced twice (params + headers). Per row: enabled checkbox (12px accent; .disabled row → opacity 0.55), key / value / description as three mono cells (description = plain editable text, no extra behaviour). Trailing always-empty row (.kv-row.empty + placeholder) auto-promotes to real row on first edit. Row delete via trailing 24px .kv-actions slot hidden by default, revealed on .kv-row:hover. {{variable}} tokens highlighted in key+value cells (.kv-cell .var), unknown ones flagged (.var.missing) vs active environment. Cell-to-cell focus movement is internal grid mechanics. Grid template 22px 1fr 1fr 1fr 24px. (Deferred/excluded mechanics enumerated in non_goals.)

users.value: Single end-user: developer editing params/headers on active request tab via keyboard+mouse — no role tiers, no collab. Developer-as-consumer: one component authored once, two mount points (params pane, headers pane). Second data-writer to acknowledge: params[]/headers[] arrays are ALSO populated programmatically by the import-from-cURL path (paste-cURL in URL bar + 'Import from cURL' command-palette action) which parses cURL into RequestSpec directly. KVTable is NOT sole writer — it is an editor-view over shared state mutable externally, so it must read/write through the existing RequestSpec store and re-render reactively when the array changes underneath it, NOT own a local copy. The cURL parse/import path itself is OUT of scope (lives with RequestBar/command-palette); this component only renders + edits the arrays correctly including when populated externally.

inputs_outputs.value: IN: (1) a bound Row[] (params or headers) from the active tab's RequestSpec store — Row = {enabled:boolean, key:string, value:string, description:string} (exact existing shape, src/renderer/src/lib/requestSpec.ts); (2) active-environment validVars set — sourced from the environment store (envSlice: activeEnvId + derived validVars) owned by env-model task T14 which is NOT yet built, so T6 reads validVars through a thin selector returning EMPTY set when the env store is absent, and degrades gracefully; (3) design tokens from tokens.css (resolved values authoritative in design/styles.css). OUT: store mutations ONLY — edit cell → update Row; first edit on empty row → append Row + spawn new trailing empty; hover-✕ → remove Row; checkbox → flip enabled. No telemetry (local-only app), no outward focus/keyboard events (cell-to-cell focus is internal grid mechanics). Missing-flag is view-local (.var.missing CSS class at render), consumed by nobody.

integration_points.value: Confirmed BUILT + reused: (1) RequestSpec store (spec 004) — bind to existing params[]/headers[] Row[], store actions are the mutation path; (2) Radix primitives (spec 001-ui-primitives) — reuse the adopted Radix Popover/combobox IF the deferred value-field completion feature is later built, no new library; (3) tokens.css — styling source. TOLERATED-ABSENT: (4) env store (T14, unshipped) — read validVars via thin selector defaulting to ∅. TWO not-yet-built deps, not one: validVars (T14) AND the parent pane-tabs container. Parent = request-pane sub-tabs strip (Params/Auth/Headers/Body/Tests/Code), reference .pane-tab strip (contract §6 'Pane tabs') / RequestSubTabs-style container — NOT in build yet (built = 001–005 + request-bar 009 + tab-contrast 011/013). So build KVTable as a SELF-CONTAINED, independently-mountable component: bound to RequestSpec params/headers arrays, testable in isolation (CT with mock rows), NOT assuming a parent exists to mount it. The pane-tabs container is a separate concern shared by T6/T7(body)/T8(auth)/T9(snippet) — own task or first task needing the shell. Phase 2 to confirm whether request-bar 009 left any sub-tab scaffold or RequestBar sits alone. T6 must NOT depend on that container being present.

constraints.value: Graceful degradation on absent env store (T14 unshipped): {{variable}} tokenising/highlighting ALWAYS works (pure local text parsing); known-vs-missing validation only activates once env store lands. Default when validVars empty → render every {{var}} as neutral .var, NOT .missing (do not flag everything unknown on a project with no environment). Env-model is NOT a hard prerequisite; T6 tolerates its absence. Reactive over shared state: read/write through existing RequestSpec store, re-render when array mutated externally (import-from-cURL), no local copy. Visual fidelity MANDATORY — exact computed-style values from design/styles.css (grid template 22px 1fr 1fr 1fr 24px, row height, mono cell font/size, header casing, padding, colour) as fidelity AC targets; var(--token) treated as resolves-to-token not literal hex. Semantic class names bound to tokens.css — NO export cruft (data-om-* attrs, __OmT wrappers, inline styles, tweaks-panel). Do NOT read tokens.json (reference-only, can drift).

non_goals.value: Autocomplete on {{variable}} value field: DEFERRED, OUT of v1 — v1 ships tokenising + highlight + missing-flag only (validVars via selector, default ∅). Autocomplete is hardest part (live combobox positioning/keyboard-nav/filtering/focus) AND data-starved until env store T14 exists; becomes its own follow-up task post-T14 that runs the Radix/Downshift/React-Aria build-vs-buy. Do NOT build now. Also OUT of v1: multi-line/expandable value cells (reference .kv-cell is single-line mono <input>; long values scroll, no textarea); per-row content-type/file-upload values (file values belong to form-data BodyEditor T7); value masking/secret-hiding (no ••• for tokens); bulk/multi-line paste-to-rows (paste k:v block exploding into rows — deferred convenience); header/param NAME validation (illegal chars etc. — v1 accepts any text, wire-level validity is http-engine T10's job). Confirmed OUT: row reorder/drag, bulk enable-disable/select-all, cURL parse/import (RequestBar/palette), env-model T14 itself (consumed not built), parent pane-tabs container (separate task T5d), telemetry.

success_criteria.value: FIDELITY: rendered grid matches design/styles.css computed values (grid template 22px 1fr 1fr 1fr 24px, row height, mono cell font/size, header casing/padding/colour) verified as fidelity ACs (var→token, not literal hex). BEHAVIOUR: auto-promote on first edit; hover-✕ delete; checkbox flips enabled + .disabled opacity; {{var}} highlight; .var.missing when validVars non-empty and token absent; neutral .var when validVars ∅. BINDING: reads/writes existing Row[] through store; re-renders reactively on external mutation (cURL import); no local copy. REUSE: one component, two mounts; testable in isolation (CT mock rows). NO export cruft: semantic classes bound to tokens.css; no data-om-*, __OmT, inline styles, tweaks-panel. THREE HARD BARS: (1) Keyboard traversal (CORE UX, not a11y polish) — Tab/Shift-Tab across cells (checkbox→key→value→description→next row); Enter in last row's value/description commits + auto-promotes with focus landing in new row; focus NEVER lost on auto-promote or delete (moves to adjacent row, not <body>). (2) Semantic form elements (powers #1) — real <input type=checkbox> (accent-color, Space-toggle free); delete-✕ a real <button> (Enter/Space focusable), NOT div-onClick. (3) CT coverage as required SCENARIOS not a %-threshold — each a CT: auto-promote on first edit; hover-✕ delete + correct focus; checkbox→enabled flip + .disabled; {{var}} known=.var/unknown=.var.missing when validVars non-empty; degradation validVars ∅ → all {{var}} neutral .var, zero .missing (assert explicitly); external array mutation (simulated cURL import) → reactive re-render no local copy; both mounts (params+headers) independent; fidelity computed-style asserts (var→token). Line-% threshold is NOT a hard bar. SOFT (not a hard bar): full screen-reader ARIA-grid roles / row labels / aria-rowindex — over-engineering for a local few-devs tool with no SR users; semantic elements (#2) give baseline a11y.

edge_cases.value: EMPTY STATE: params [] → only trailing empty row renders; deleting last real row leaves the empty row (never zero rows). TRAILING-EMPTY ROW has NO delete affordance — ✕ appears only on promoted (real) rows; empty row can't be deleted (never-zero guard). PASTE into a cell: single-line paste = literal text; multi-line paste (\n in clipboard) must NOT explode into rows (bulk-paste OUT of v1) — collapse newlines to spaces (don't lose text, don't spawn rows). {{var}} TOKENISER: captures everything between {{ and }}, trimmed ({{ x }} → key 'x'), compares exact trimmed string against validVars keys. Do NOT constrain name to \w+ — env keys may contain dots/dashes/unicode ({{user.id}}, {{user-id}}); \w-only regex would false-flag them missing. Known ⟺ trimmed ∈ validVars. Empty {{}} and unclosed {{abc (no closing }}) = plain text, neither .var nor .missing (requires both delimiters + non-empty key). Nested {{a{{b}}}}: non-greedy — shortest {{...}} match, locked. Key vs value tokenised independently. DUPLICATE KEYS (same name twice): allowed, no merge/warn (wire-level is T10). LONG VALUES: single-line scroll, no wrap/no grid reflow. EXTERNAL MUTATION RACES: cURL import replaces array while a cell is focused/mid-edit → reactive re-render must not crash or resurrect stale local edits (no-local-copy is the guard). DELETE-WHILE-FOCUSED ordering: move focus to adjacent row (same column; previous row, or next if deleting first) BEFORE removing, so focus never falls to <body>. RAPID AUTO-PROMOTE incl paste: fast typing OR large paste into empty row spawns exactly ONE new trailing row (promote fires on first non-empty state, idempotent), never N. validVars TOGGLING: env store lands or activeEnv switches mid-session → highlight re-evaluates reactively. NOT edge-cases for v1: virtualization for huge row counts (params/headers realistically <50); cross-mount races (params + headers separate arrays, can't collide).

No autocomplete.
